tasks.definition: Build bounded first implementation: Import source-bound records for at least thirty previous numbered laboratories, with discovery coverage stated.
Build bounded first implementation: Expose read-only selected source pages through an allowlisted loopback service without altering sibling files.
Build bounded first implementation: Provide fifteen distinct model families and fifteen declared configurations in each session, with 3D projections and explicit time or parameter dimensions.
Build bounded first implementation: Compare results with known examples, conservation laws and boundary counterexamples; retain failed candidates separately.
Build bounded first implementation: Define symbols, units, symmetry, conservation and limiting requirements for both equation forms without inventing measured coefficients.
Build bounded first implementation: Demonstrate discretization limits and necessary conservation conditions; keep continuum and empirical claims open.
Build bounded first implementation: Make bounded attempts on named mathematical, physical and philosophical questions, with exact unsolved scope and no solution inflation.
Build bounded first implementation: Compare GR, computation, governance and Christian ethical themes using distinct epistemic criteria.
Build bounded first implementation: Implement issuer, subject, claim and evidence envelopes that cannot turn software roles into legal identity or consciousness.
Build bounded first implementation: Model scope, expiry, withdrawal and correction as declared transitions; test a revoked-access counterexample.
Build bounded first implementation: Inspect explicit allocation and voting assumptions, including incompatible fairness requirements.
Build bounded first implementation: Record human-controlled workload, failure burden and resource limits as operational metadata, with no subjective wellbeing inference.
Build bounded first implementation: Catalogue every installed direct skill, group discovery usefully and add a single main entrypoint without declaring lexical equivalence.
Build bounded first implementation: Consolidate provenance, workflow, simulation, capability-query and claim-check operations behind strict public JSON contracts.
Build bounded first implementation: Create, install and manually exercise five useful hooks; record live host observation separately and use available coordinator start/end entrypoints.
Build bounded first implementation: Publish current limits and all numbered assignments from Avelin v707-v6 through Eiren v725-v8, with an interstitial remaster and one terminal successor.
Build bounded first implementation: Verify Codex, Node, PowerShell and package state, preserve context settings, update selected stable tools only when warranted and report OS elevation accurately.
Build bounded first implementation: Recover historical Nexus intent and implement portable sanitized exports and a concrete cloud adapter contract; use an available authorized remote bank.
Build bounded first implementation: Bind inputs and results, reject traversal and oversized requests, retain source failures, and provide an inspectable rollback path.
Build bounded first implementation: Seal owned exact Git blobs once, keep Method Flow separate, produce a file-backed baton of at least 2000 words and resolve only the Caelen Ash v707-v7 edge.
